subject.title: All LLM API calls time out simultaneously despite APIs being reachable (multi-agent concurrency issue)

question: Should this issue stay as the canonical multi-agent Telegram/provider timeout investigation until a live current-main repro identifies the bottleneck, or should maintainers split it now into narrower fallback, Telegram concurrency, and launch-environment work?
rationale: Current main includes partial fallback mitigations, but the remaining requested fixes cross channel runtime, provider transport, config/env defaults, and operator guidance, which automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep canonical and require live repro
options.body: Keep this issue open, collect a current-main four-agent Telegram trace with provider curl comparison, then promote only the proven narrow fix path.

options.title: Split narrow follow-ups now
options.body: Create separate maintainer-owned issues for Telegram runner concurrency, provider/DNS transport, and launch environment defaults, then close this issue only after those links preserve the original report.

options.title: Treat partial mitigations as enough
options.body: Accept the merged fallback-cascade work as sufficient and close this report, with the risk that the original simultaneous timeout bottleneck remains unverified.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical and require live repro
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, collect a current-main four-agent Telegram trace with provider curl comparison, then promote only the proven narrow fix path.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent broad fallback/channel-area touches point to `steipete` as the best available routing owner for the product-boundary decision.
